narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts (US-Iran, Israel-Hezbollah, Ukraine-Russia) escalate beyond controlled tit-for-tat. The Apache shootdown, Hormuz blockade persistence, and asymmetric threats from Iran are driving a systemic repricing of geopolitical risk, with equities breaking key support levels.
narratives.trade_implication: Short S&P 500 futures or buy VIX calls; long gold and short-dated US Treasuries as safe havens.

narratives.title: Oil Supply Disruption Premium
narratives.summary: Capital is rotating into oil and energy assets as the Hormuz blockade structurally tightens supply, with EIA forecasting recovery only by 2027. The SPR release is misread as bearish but actually signals government concern, while Kuwait's pipeline bypass talks confirm the blockade's bite.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude futures and energy sector ETFs; consider long-dated oil call spreads.

narratives.title: Crypto as Macro Risk Proxy
narratives.summary: Bitcoin's crash mirrors broad risk-off moves, not crypto-specific weakness, as institutions de-risk amid geopolitical turmoil. Whale accumulation and MicroStrategy buying at the dip suggest underlying support, but capital flows are dominated by macro hedging rather than crypto conviction.
narratives.trade_implication: Neutral on BTC; consider short-term puts on crypto proxies like COIN or MSTR, but accumulate spot BTC on further dips.
